luqman.note: Technical base of Nuvio Avix. New commits are proposed as a merge pull request into the base branch.

upstream.note: Original NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile (the fork parent). Merged when Luqman lags behind it.

yesnt.note: Never merged (its history silently deletes upstream files). New commits are reported for manual porting; see docs/integration/YESNT_PORT_LEDGER.md.

mpvlib.note: app.gyrolet.mpvlib:mpvlib (mpvRx engine). Update only after the MpvRx engine tests pass.

mpvRx.note: Reference for libmpv options/behaviour only (AGPL-3.0). Never copy UI or shaders.

ass-media.note: io.github.peerless2012:ass-media used by the ExoPlayer path.
